note: A second pass over the Malaysian corpus on Open Food Facts, picking up what the first crawl left behind. Two kinds of row are here. Most are records the first pass never reached — the country crawl was re-run in full and every barcode it had already taken was excluded. The rest are the recovery job: records that carry nutrition per 100 g and no serving_size at all, which the first crawl dropped wholesale. Those are priced as the WHOLE PACK, and only where the pack is plainly one sitting — a 250 ml carton, a 40 g biscuit sleeve, a 90 g instant-noodle pack. A 1 kg bag of flour or a 2 L bottle has no honest single serving in the record and is not here at all; per-100 g figures were never scaled to a portion nobody printed. Every row was recomputed as 4·carbs + 4·protein + 9·fat against its stated energy and thrown out past 25%, and thrown out again where the macros weighed more than the serving holding them. source names the barcode.
